parameters.content:
## Attendance Warning Notifications

The portal POSTs a finalized nested attendance-warning snapshot. The workflow validates and stores the batch, flattens student/course records, compares them with the stored warning state, sends one change notification (silently skipping pure 0->1 transitions), embeds a progress bar + open-tracking pixel in the email, logs a read receipt row, logs delivery, and upserts the new state.

Level 3 - Drop uses an urgent red HTML email. Email Test Config can redirect all mail to a controlled recipient.

IMPORTANT: set PIXEL_BASE_URL in 'Compute Notifications' to your real n8n webhook URL for the 'Email Open Pixel Tracker' workflow, and set the dataTableId in 'Insert Read Receipts' to your email_read_receipts table id.

### Synchronous responses
- 400 invalid payload (accepted:false, error)
- 200 duplicate batch_id (accepted:true, duplicate:true)
- 500 storage failure before acceptance (accepted:false)
- 202 accepted after durable store (accepted:true, duplicate:false)

Invalid payloads never update warning state or send notifications.

## First run

When no warning-state rows exist, the first valid snapshot establishes the baseline and sends no notifications. Later snapshots notify only when a warning level changes, a non-Good course first appears, or a tracked course disappears.

## Chunked finalize-day ingestion

Each POST is now ONE CHUNK of a day's finalize run, not the whole day:
{ finalize_id, chunk_index, chunk_count, finalized_at, students: [...] }

Dedup is per (finalize_id, chunk_index) - stored internally as batch_id = finalize_id + ':' + chunk_index, so the existing dedup/storage nodes didn't need to change.

After a chunk finishes successfully, 'Load/Compute/Update|Insert Finalize Progress' increments a counter in attendance_finalize_runs and marks the whole finalize_id 'completed' once chunks_received reaches chunk_count. This is informational only (for monitoring 'did today's finalize fully land') - it does not gate or block anything downstream.

SETUP: create a new Data Table 'attendance_finalize_runs' with columns finalize_id, chunk_count, chunks_received, first_chunk_at, completed_at, status - then point both new data-table nodes at it. Also add finalize_id/chunk_index/chunk_count columns to your existing attendance_finalize_batches table (Store Batch now writes to them).
